name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
s

NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 24, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Members of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89819558081
  Webinar ID: 898 1955 8081
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16699009128,,89819558081# OR +16694449171,,89819558081#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 719 359 4580 OR +1 253 205 0468

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of January 10, 2024 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the printed
agenda and within the Council’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three minutes.
Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom
teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a
Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE REPORT – LINDERO CANYON ROAD
  SIDEWALK AND LANDSCAPE PARKWAY IMPROVEMENTS - BARONSGATE
  TO LAKEVIEW CANYON ROAD - No action required; further staff and committee
  work will be needed. Staff did want to provide an update to the City Council to receive
  input as staff and the Environmental Committee continue to work on this project before
  returning to Council for action at a future Council meeting.
 PUBLIC HEARING:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-006; RESOLUTION NO. 2332-24 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2332-24, determining Conditional Use Permit No. 23-006 is exempt
  from CEQA and approving CUP 23-006 to authorize the installation and operation
  of a new rooftop wireless telecommunications facility to be located at 5716 Corsa
  Avenue.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2332-24 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-006 RELATIVE TO THE
  INSTALLATION AND OPERATION OF A NEW ROOFTOP WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS
  FACILITY AT 5716 CORSA AVENUE

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective January 15, 2024 in the amount
  of $ 870,763.54

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  CEQA REVIEW OF PROPOSED LINDERO TERRACE PROJECT —
  PROFESSIONAL  SERVICES  AGREEMENT  WITH  MERIDIAN
  CONSULTANTS; REIMBURSEMENT AGREEMENT WITH ROSE
  EQUITIES AND GARDEN COMMUNITIES – Approve a Professional
  Services Agreement with Meridian Consultants for CEQA review of the
  proposed Lindero Terrace Project; approve a Reimbursement Agreement
  with Rose Equities and Garden Communities for payment of costs and
  expenses associated with such review; and authorize the Mayor to execute
  these contracts.

  2.  2024 APPOINTMENTS TO THE COMMUNITY SERVICE GRANT
  ADVISORY COMMITTEE - Appoint the recommended panel of Mark Luther,
  Chad Martinson, Gladys Lopez, Marty Blumenthal and Christine “Teena”
  Wong to the 2024 Community Service Grant Advisory Committee.

OLD BUSINESS: None
 NEW BUSINESS:

1.  ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR THE
  ANNUAL STREET RESURFACING PROGRAM FY 2023-24 - Adopt the plans and
  specifications for the Annual Street Resurfacing Program FY 2023-24 and authorize
  staff to advertise bids for the construction of the Annual Street Resurfacing Program
  FY 2023-24.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, January 18, 2024 at 5:30 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  January 18, 2024
